package repository

import "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"

// LessonExampleRepository stores first-class instructional examples.
type LessonExampleRepository interface {
	ReplaceByLesson(ctx Context, lessonID string, examples []domain.LessonExample) error
	Get(ctx Context, exampleID string) (*domain.LessonExample, error)
	ListByLesson(ctx Context, lessonID string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExample, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, exampleID string) error
}

// LessonExampleRelationRepository stores directed semantic example links.
type LessonExampleRelationRepository interface {
	ReplaceBySourceExample(ctx Context, sourceExampleID string, relations []domain.LessonExampleRelation) error
	ListBySourceExample(ctx Context, sourceExampleID string, activeOnly bool) ([]domain.LessonExampleRelation, error)
	Delete(ctx Context, relationID string) error
}
